items.en: Latin platea took over the borrowed word for a street or open space in a town.
items.cn: 拉丁语 platea 接过这个借词，指城中的街道或空地。

items.en: Old French place kept both the street sense and a general sense of location.
items.cn: 古法语 place 既保留街道义，也有泛指地点之义。

items.en: English borrowed it in the twelfth century; the senses of rank, home and duty grew inside English.
items.cn: 十二世纪英语借入该词；名次、住所与本分诸义都在英语内部生长。

items.en: Conversion produced the verb to place, plus compounds from marketplace to placement.
items.cn: 转类产生动词 place，并衍生出 marketplace 到 placement 等复合词。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the place family; the near-meaning group gathers spots and positions.
note.cn: 形近组收 place 词族；近义组收地点与位置词。

entries.definition: To put something back or take its position; the same root with a new prefix.
entries.definitionCN: 放回原处或取代之；同根加新前缀。

entries.definition: To force something out of its position, physically or socially.
entries.definitionCN: 把某物从其位置上挤走，物理或社会意义皆可。

entries.definition: The act or arrangement of placing someone somewhere.
entries.definitionCN: 安置行为或安排。

entries.definition: A precise spot, often technical or fixed by coordinates.
entries.definitionCN: 确切的地点，常指技术性或坐标固定的位置。

entries.definition: A spot marked for a building, event or activity.
entries.definitionCN: 为建筑、事件或活动划定的场地。

entries.definition: A small, particular place, informal and immediate.
entries.definitionCN: 小而具体的地方，口语、当场性。

normalIntro.en: Memory hangs on one image: a hand setting something into its slot.
normalIntro.cn: 记忆挂在同一个意象上：一只手把东西放进格位。

normal.en: Place, replace, displace: one root with three fates for a slot.
normal.cn: place、replace、displace：一个词根，格位的三种命运。

normal.en: Take place means events also get placed — into time instead of space.
normal.cn: take place 说明事件也会被安放——放进时间而非空间。

normal.en: Come to my place shrinks all geography to your front door.
normal.cn: come to my place 把全部地理缩到你的前门。

normal.en: First place, second place: ranks are places you can hold.
normal.cn: 第一名、第二名：名次也是可以占据的位置。

normal.en: Out of place is a person set into the wrong slot.
normal.cn: out of place 是被放错格子的人。

abstract.en: A palm opening, an object settling into it, then into its resting spot.
abstract.cn: 手掌摊开，物件落进掌心，再落进它的安放处。

abstract.en: A podium with numbered blocks, each waiting to be filled.
abstract.cn: 带编号座位的领奖台，每个格子等着被填上。

abstract.en: A wide sunlit street narrowing to a single marked doorway.
abstract.cn: 一条宽宽的、阳光照着的街道，收窄成一个画了记号的门洞。

examples.en: The wedding will take place in the garden.
examples.cn: 婚礼将在花园里举行。

examples.en: Please place your bags under the seat in front of you.
examples.cn: 请把包放在前排座椅下方。

examples.en: She earned first place in the national contest.
examples.cn: 她在全国比赛中得了第一名。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「普雷斯」——普天下的东西都要安放在该放的地方；place 就是位置。

root: place 源自希腊语 plateia（宽阔的街道），经拉丁语 platea、古法语 place 进入英语；由「街道」到「地点」，再引申出位置、名次与安置动词。

sensesIntro.en: A broad Greek street narrows into spot, slot and rank, then opens again as the verb of setting things and people into place.
sensesIntro.cn: 一条宽阔的希腊街道收窄为地点、格位与名次，再以动词的身份打开，把事物与人安放进位。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a slot in the world where a thing or person belongs.
core.cn: 核心意象：世界里一个属于某物或某人的格位。

branches.en: the corner café claimed as yours
branches.cn: 被你认作自留地的街角咖啡馆

branches.en: third place on the podium
the front door that means come home
branches.cn: 意味着「回家」的那扇前门

branches.en: the vase centred with one careful motion
branches.cn: 一次细致动作放正的花瓶

branches.en: from the spot on the map to the job secured
branches.cn: 从地图上的点到安排妥当的工作

intro.en: Place is a Latin-French trunk that grew a large family of prefixes and compounds inside English.
intro.cn: place 是拉丁—法语主干，在英语内部长出一个庞大的前缀与复合家族。

latinIntro.en: The Greek-Latin root plat- (broad, flat) underlies place, plateau and platypus alike.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊—拉丁词根 plat-（宽、平）同时支撑 place、plateau 与 platypus。

latinEntries.meaning: an English derivative of the headword
latinEntries.meaningCN: place 加前缀 re- 构成，义为「取代；替换」

latinEntries.meaning: an English derivative of the headword
latinEntries.meaningCN: place 加 -ment 构成，义为「安置」

definition_zh: 平原；朴素的；简单的；不加修饰的；坦率的
definition_en: a large flat area of land, or simple without decoration, or clear and direct
core_image: 一片没有任何起伏和装饰的平地——同样平坦的还有衣料、话语和食物
scene: 火车驶出丘陵，窗外忽然展开一望无际的大平原。We crossed the vast plain in less than an hour.
sceneCN: 这里是「平原」（第 1 个义项：大片平坦的陆地）；句意为不到一小时我们就穿过了辽阔的平原。画面就是那片平得望不到边的土地。

pos.zh: 朴素的；简单的；坦率的；不加奶的

derivatives.zh: plain 加副词后缀 -ly，义为「朴素地； plainly 明白地」
plain 加 -ness 构成的名词，义为「朴素；平易」
plain 与 spoken 合成，义为「说话直率的」

senses.title: A large flat area of land
senses.definition: a wide area of flat land with few trees
senses.definitionCN: 几乎没有树木的大片平地
senses.example: Buffalo once covered the American plains.
senses.exampleCN: 野牛曾经遍布美洲大平原。
senses.why: Latin planus described flatness, and the land sense kept the most literal meaning.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 planus 指平坦，土地义保留了最字面的意思。

senses.title: Without decoration
senses.definition: simple and without ornament or pattern
senses.definitionCN: 简单而没有任何装饰或花纹
senses.example: She wore a plain grey dress to the interview.
senses.exampleCN: 她穿了条素净的灰裙子去面试。
senses.why: A flat surface carries no carving or colour, so flatness became visual simplicity.
senses.whyCN: 平的表面没有雕饰与色彩，平坦便成了视觉上的简朴。

senses.title: Easy to understand
senses.definition: easy to understand because it is stated directly
senses.definitionCN: 因为说得直接而易于理解
senses.example: Keep the instructions plain and short.
senses.exampleCN: 说明要写得简单明了。
senses.why: An uncluttered surface is easy to see across, so the image slid to uncluttered meaning.
senses.whyCN: 没有遮挡的表面一眼望穿，意象便滑向了不绕弯子的意思。

senses.title: Direct and honest in speech
senses.definition: saying exactly what is thought, without politeness padding
senses.definitionCN: 把想法原样说出，不加客套粉饰
senses.example: To be plain with you, the plan will fail.
senses.exampleCN: 直说吧，这个计划会失败。
senses.why: Flatness applied to words means no decorated curves, only the straight line of truth.
senses.whyCN: 平坦用于话语即没有装饰的曲线，只有真理的直线。

senses.title: Ordinary, not special
senses.definition: ordinary and not beautiful or impressive
senses.definitionCN: 普通而不漂亮、不惊人的
senses.example: He's a plain man with plain habits.
senses.exampleCN: 他是个长相普通、习惯平常的人。
senses.why: No decoration and no surprise leaves only the ordinary, so plain slid to unremarkable.
senses.whyCN: 没有装饰也没有意外，只剩平常，plain 便滑向「不起眼」。

senses.title: Without milk or sugar
senses.definition: food or drink with nothing added, especially without milk
senses.definitionCN: 什么都没加的食物或饮料，尤指不加奶
senses.example: I take my coffee plain.
senses.exampleCN: 我喝咖啡什么都不加。
senses.why: The bare surface again: nothing poured, sprinkled or stirred into it.
senses.whyCN: 又是那个光秃秃的表面：什么都没倒进去、撒进去、搅进去。

intro.en: Plain is Latin planus, flat, that reached English twice — once through French for the adjective and noun, and once as the word plain itself.
intro.cn: plain 来自拉丁语 planus（平的），经法语两次进入英语——形容词名词走一条路，同源词另有走法。

items.en: Planus meant flat or level, spreading on the ground.
items.cn: 拉丁语 planus 意为平的、水平的，向地面铺展。

items.en: Old French plain and plein carried flatness and also fullness, the two cousins of one root.
items.cn: 古法语 plain 与 plein 兼有「平」与「满」两义，同根兄弟。

items.en: The word entered English with the flat-land sense and the clear, unadorned sense together.
items.cn: 该词进入英语时便同时带着平地义与清楚、不加修饰义。

items.en: The land sense kept the spelling plain, while the fullness sense settled as plain and the plane of geometry.
items.cn: 土地义沿用 plain 拼法，而「满」义与几何的平面分道为 plane。

items.en: Today plain covers land, dress, speech, food and the humble ordinary face.
items.cn: 今天 plain 覆盖土地、衣着、话语、饮食与平凡的面孔。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the planus family; the near-meaning group gathers flatness and directness.
note.cn: 形近组收 planus 词族；近义组收平坦与直率词。

entries.definition: A flat surface, a tool or an aircraft; the twin spelling that split from plain.
entries.definitionCN: 平面、刨子或飞机；与 plain 分道而来的孪生拼法。

entries.definition: A flat stretch of highland, or a stage where progress stops.
entries.definitionCN: 高原，或进步停滞的平台期。

entries.definition: To make something flat and clear to the mind.
entries.definitionCN: 把某事在头脑中摊平、说清楚。

entries.definition: Easy and basic, without complexity of any kind.
entries.definitionCN: 容易而基本，没有任何复杂成分。

entries.definition: Level and lacking emotion or fizz; the physical twin of plain.
entries.definitionCN: 平的、乏味的；plain 的物理孪生词。

entries.definition: Direct to the point of rudeness in speech.
entries.definitionCN: 直率到近乎无礼。

normalIntro.en: One Latin root, one picture: something laid flat, with nothing added.
normalIntro.cn: 一个拉丁词根、一幅画：被摊平的东西，什么也没添加。

normal.en: Planus, plain, plane: flatness wearing three costumes.
normal.cn: planus、plain、plane：平坦穿着三套戏服。

normal.en: A plain is flat land; plain clothes is a flat, undecorated outfit.
normal.cn: plain 是平地；plain clothes 是无装饰的衣服。

normal.en: In plain English means words spread out flat where all can read them.
normal.cn: in plain English 是把话摊平，人人能读。

normal.en: Plain yogurt carries the bare surface into the fridge.
normal.cn: plain yogurt 把光秃秃的表面带进冰箱。

normal.en: To be plain with you flattens every curve out of the sentence.
normal.cn: to be plain with you 把句子里的每条弯都压直。

abstract.en: Grass running to the horizon with not a single hill to break it.
abstract.cn: 草地一直跑到地平线，没有一座山丘打断。

abstract.en: A grey dress with no buttons, no lace, no shine.
abstract.cn: 一条灰裙，没有纽扣、没有花边、没有光泽。

abstract.en: A sentence with all decoration stripped off, standing like a bare plank.
abstract.cn: 一句话被剥掉所有装饰，像一块光板立着。

examples.en: The farmhouse stood alone on the wide plain.
examples.cn: 农舍孤零零立在广阔的平原上。

examples.en: She gave us the plain facts, without comfort.
examples.cn: 她把无情的事实直说了，没有安慰。

examples.en: He prefers plain yogurt to the sweetened kind.
examples.cn: 比起加糖的，他更喜欢原味酸奶。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「铺累嗯」——平平地铺到累嗯，一马平川；plain 就是平原、朴素。

root: plain 源自拉丁语 planus（平坦的），经古法语 plain/plein 进入英语；「平」义引申出平原、朴素、直率等义；与 plane、plateau、explain 同根。

sensesIntro.en: Latin flatness grows into a prairie, an unadorned dress, a direct sentence, an ordinary face and a cup of coffee with nothing added.
sensesIntro.cn: 拉丁语的平坦长成一片草原、一件素裙、一句直话、一张平常的脸和一杯什么都没加的咖啡。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a flat surface with nothing added and nothing hidden.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个平坦的表面，没加任何东西，也没有任何遮挡。

branches.en: the prairie to the horizon
the dress with no ornament
the sentence that walks straight
the face no one describes twice
branches.cn: 没人想多描述一次的脸

branches.en: from clear words to bare coffee

intro.en: Plain's family is the Latin root planus in many costumes, joined by English suffixes.
intro.cn: plain 的词族是拉丁词根 planus 的多套戏服，再加英语词尾。

latinIntro.en: The root planus also lives in plateau, plane, explain and plan.
latinIntro.cn: 词根 planus 还活在 plateau、plane、explain 与 plan 里。

latinEntries.meaning: an English derivative of the headword
latinEntries.meaningCN: plain 加 -ly 构成，义为「朴素地；明白地」

latinEntries.meaning: an English derivative of the headword
latinEntries.meaningCN: plain 加 -ness 构成，义为「朴素」

definition_zh: 计划；方案；平面图；规划（动词）
definition_en: a set of decisions about what to do in the future, or a drawing of a building layout, or to decide things in advance
core_image: 在纸板上摊平的一张图——未来的每一步都先在平面上走一遍
scene: 出发前一周，她把旅行路线一格格画进笔记本。We planned the whole trip around two days in Kyoto.
sceneCN: 这里是「规划」（第 4 个义项：预先安排好）；句意为我们把整个旅行计划安排成以京都两天为核心。画面就是那张在纸面先走一遍的路线图。

derivatives.zh: plan 加 -er 构成的施动名词，义为「规划者；日程本」
plan 的动名词，义为「规划；计划工作」
plan 的过去分词作形容词，义为「有计划的」

senses.title: A decided course of action
senses.definition: an intention or set of decisions about future action
senses.definitionCN: 对未来行动的打算或一组决定
senses.example: Our plan is to leave before sunrise.
senses.exampleCN: 我们打算日出前动身。
senses.why: Latin planus, flat, gave the idea of spreading everything out on a level surface to see it whole.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 planus（平的）给出意象：把一切摊平在一个平面上，看全整体。

senses.title: A drawing of a building layout
senses.definition: a drawing that shows the layout of a building or area from above
senses.definitionCN: 从上方显示建筑或区域布局的图纸
senses.example: The architect unrolled the plan of the second floor.
senses.exampleCN: 建筑师展开了二楼的平面图。
senses.why: A building flattened onto paper is literally made planus, flat — the drawing keeps the root's oldest sense.
senses.whyCN: 建筑被摊平到纸上，字面意义上就是 planus（弄平）——图纸保住了词根最老的含义。

senses.title: A scheme or method
senses.definition: a systematic method for achieving something
senses.definitionCN: 达成某事的系统性方法
senses.example: The company cut costs under a new savings plan.
senses.exampleCN: 公司按新的节约方案削减成本。
senses.why: The future, too, gets flattened: steps laid out side by side like rooms on a drawing.
senses.whyCN: 未来同样被摊平：各步骤像图纸上的房间一样并排铺开。

senses.title: To decide in advance
senses.definition: to decide and arrange something before it happens
senses.definitionCN: 在某事发生前做出决定和安排
senses.example: They planned the launch for October.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把发布会安排在十月。
senses.why: The noun became a verb by conversion: to draw the future on paper before living it.
senses.whyCN: 名词转类成动词：先在纸上把未来画一遍，再去过它。

senses.title: To intend or want
senses.definition: to have something in mind as a goal
senses.definitionCN: 把某事放在心里当作目标
senses.example: I'm planning to study abroad next year.
senses.exampleCN: 我打算明年出国读书。
senses.why: The drawing narrows to the intention: the picture of the future reduced to a wish.
senses.whyCN: 图纸收窄成意图：对未来的图景缩成一个心愿。

intro.en: Plan was reshaped from French plan, drawn from Latin planus, flat — a future or a building pressed flat onto paper.
intro.cn: plan 由法语 plan 整形而来，法语又取自拉丁语 planus（平的）——未来或建筑被压平到纸上。

items.en: Planus meant flat, level, spread out.
items.cn: 拉丁语 planus 意为平的、水平的、铺开的。

items.en: French plan took the word from Latin planum for a ground drawing; English had earlier borrowed plain for the adjective.
items.cn: 法语 plan 从拉丁语 planum 借得「地面图」之义；英语更早已把形容词借成 plain。

items.en: Plan entered English in the seventeenth century first for architectural drawings, then for schemes.
items.cn: plan 于十七世纪进入英语，先指建筑图，后指方案。

items.en: American usage broadened plan to any intended course of action.
items.cn: 美国用法把 plan 扩大到任何打算采取的行动。

items.en: Now plan runs from floor plans to pension plans, and converts freely into a verb.
items.cn: 如今 plan 从楼层图排到养老金计划，并自由转类成动词。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the planus family; the near-meaning group gathers intentions and schemes.
note.cn: 形近组收 planus 词族；近义组收打算与方案词。

entries.definition: A flat surface, a smoothing tool or an aircraft; one letter apart from plan.
entries.definitionCN: 平面、刨子或飞机；与 plan 相差一个字母。

entries.definition: Flat highland; the same planus root in French spelling.
entries.definitionCN: 平坦的高地；同一 planus 词根的法语拼法。

entries.definition: A checked wool pattern; rhymes with plan but comes from Scottish Gaelic.
entries.definitionCN: 格纹毛料；与 plan 押韵，却来自苏格兰盖尔语。

entries.definition: A systematic plan, sometimes with a hint of trickery.
entries.definitionCN: 系统性的计划，有时带点诡计意味。

entries.definition: What one means to do, before any detailed steps exist.
entries.definitionCN: 想要做的事，尚无具体步骤。

entries.definition: A planned arrangement, of objects or of purposes.
entries.definitionCN: 有计划的安排，既指物也指意图。

normalIntro.en: Remember the flattened picture: everything future is spread out flat on paper first.
normalIntro.cn: 记住那张摊平的图：一切未来都先在纸上摊平。

normal.en: Plan and plain are twins of planus: flatness becomes clarity, clarity becomes a scheme.
normal.cn: plan 与 plain 是 planus 的双生子：平坦变成清晰，清晰变成方案。

normal.en: A floor plan is literally the building pressed flat.
normal.cn: 楼层平面图就是把建筑压平。

normal.en: Plan ahead repeats itself: the plan already points forward.
normal.cn: plan ahead 是同义重复：plan 本来就指向未来。

normal.en: Game plan borrows the coach's chalkboard drawing.
normal.cn: game plan 借用教练黑板上的战术图。

normal.en: The noun doubles as verb: you can plan a plan.
normal.cn: 名词兼任动词：可以 plan a plan。

abstract.en: A blank paper where the future lies down flat, room by room.
abstract.cn: 一张白纸，未来在其中逐间摊平躺下。

abstract.en: A ruler and pencil drawing tomorrow before tomorrow arrives.
abstract.cn: 尺与铅笔在明天到来之前先画出明天。

abstract.en: Steps laid side by side like rooms in a corridor.
abstract.cn: 步骤像走廊里的房间一样并排铺开。

examples.en: Everything went according to plan.
examples.cn: 一切都按计划进行。

examples.en: The plan shows where each wall and window sits.
examples.cn: 图纸上标出了每面墙和每扇窗的位置。

examples.en: We planned to meet at the station at noon.
examples.cn: 我们约好中午在车站碰面。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「扑烂」——计划赶不上变化，图纸扑烂了也照旧；plan 就是计划。

root: plan 源自拉丁语 planus/planum（平的），经法语 plan（地面图）于十七世纪进入英语；由「摊平的图纸」引申出计划、方案与动词义；与 plain、plane、plateau 同根。

sensesIntro.en: Flatness on paper becomes foresight: a drawing of rooms widens into a drawing of the future.
sensesIntro.cn: 纸上的平坦变成预见：房间的图纸扩展成未来的图纸。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the future pressed flat onto paper, drawn before it is lived.
core.cn: 核心意象：未来被压平到纸上，先画出来，再活出来。

branches.en: the route decided before the road
the building laid out from above
branches.cn: 从上方摊开的建筑布局

branches.en: the date circled in advance
the wish that turns into steps
from intention to systematic method

intro.en: Plan is a short borrowed noun whose family is the planus root plus plain English endings.
intro.cn: plan 是短小的借入名词，词族为 planus 词根加朴素的英语词尾。

latinIntro.en: The planus root also gave plain, plane, plateau and explain.
latinIntro.cn: planus 词根还给了 plain、plane、plateau 与 explain。

latinEntries.meaning: an English derivative of the headword
latinEntries.meaningCN: plan 加 -er 构成，义为「规划者」

latinEntries.meaning: an English derivative of the headword
latinEntries.meaningCN: plan 的动名词，义为「规划」

definition_zh: 平面；飞机；刨子；平面刨（动词）；悬铃木
definition_en: a flat surface, an aircraft with wings, or a tool that smooths wood, or a tall shade tree
core_image: 一块没有厚度的平——平的表面、平掠天空的机翼、推平木头的刨子
scene: 头顶传来轰鸣，孩子仰头指着掠过云层的那架飞机。A plane crossed the sky leaving a line of white smoke.
sceneCN: 这里是「飞机」（第 3 个义项： aeroplane 的简称）；句意为一架飞机划过天空留下白烟。画面就是那道掠过云层的机影。

pos.zh: 平面；水平；飞机；刨子；悬铃木

derivatives.zh: air 与 plane 合成，义为「飞机」（美式常用）
aero- 与 plane 合成，义为「飞机」（英式传统拼法）
plane 加 -er 构成的名词，义为「刨床；刨工」

senses.title: A flat surface
senses.definition: a flat or level surface that extends in two dimensions
senses.definitionCN: 在两个维度上延展的平坦表面
senses.example: The painter kept every plane of the canvas in balance.
senses.exampleCN: 画家让画布上的每个平面都保持均衡。
senses.why: Latin planus, flat, named the ideal surface without thickness or curve.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 planus（平的）命名了没有厚度没有弧度的理想表面。

senses.title: A level of thought or existence
senses.definition: a level of thought, development or existence
senses.definitionCN: 思想、发展或存在的层次
senses.example: They argued on a purely practical plane.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在一个纯粹务实的层面上争论。
senses.why: The geometric surface lifted into metaphor: ideas arranged on invisible flat levels.
senses.whyCN: 几何表面升为隐喻：思想排布在看不见的平层上。

senses.title: An aircraft
senses.definition: a flying vehicle with fixed wings and engines
senses.definitionCN: 有固定机翼和发动机的飞行器
senses.example: The plane landed ten minutes early.
senses.exampleCN: 飞机提前十分钟落地。
senses.why: Shortened from aeroplane, built on the same flat surface idea: wings that glide on level air.
senses.whyCN: 由 aeroplane 缩略而来，仍建立在同一平面上：在水平气流上滑翔的机翼。

senses.title: A woodworking tool
senses.definition: a tool with a blade that shaves wood to a smooth flat finish
senses.definitionCN: 装着刀片、把木头刨得平整光滑的工具
senses.example: He smoothed the door edge with a hand plane.
senses.exampleCN: 他用手工刨把门边刨平。
senses.why: The tool literally makes wood planus, flat — the most physical sense of the root.
senses.whyCN: 这工具字面上就是把木头弄平（planus）——词根最物理的义项。

senses.title: To smooth wood with a plane
senses.definition: to shave wood flat with a plane
senses.definitionCN: 用刨子把木头刨平
senses.example: She planed the rough board until it shone.
senses.exampleCN: 她把粗木板刨到发亮。
senses.why: The tool name became a verb by conversion: to do to wood what the plane does.
senses.whyCN: 工具名转类成动词：对木头做刨子做的事。

senses.title: A tall shade tree
senses.definition: a large tree with maple-like leaves, often planted along streets
senses.definitionCN: 叶似枫树的高大乔木，常作行道树
senses.example: The plane trees shaded the whole boulevard.
senses.exampleCN: 悬铃木给整条林荫大道遮了荫。
senses.why: A different Latin word, platanus, gave this sense — a coincidence of sound, not of meaning.
senses.whyCN: 这一义来自另一个拉丁词 platanus——只是音同，并非义通。

intro.en: English plane is three words in one spelling: Latin planus for surfaces, Latin platanus for the tree, and a shortened aeroplane for the machine.
intro.cn: 英语的 plane 是三个词共用一个拼法：拉丁语 planus 指表面，platanus 指树，另有缩略自 aeroplane 的机器。

items.en: Planus meant flat or level; planum was the flat surface itself.
items.cn: 拉丁语 planus 意为平的；planum 指平面本身。

items.en: French plan carried the geometric sense into learned European writing.
items.cn: 法语 plan 把几何义带进欧洲学术写作。

items.en: The geometric plane and the carpenter's plane both settled in English by the seventeenth century.
items.cn: 到十七世纪，几何平面与木工刨都已落户英语。

items.en: Platanus, from Greek platanos, named the broad plane tree and gave the third homophone.
items.cn: platanus（源自希腊语 platanos）命名了宽叶悬铃木，构成第三个同音词。

items.en: Aeroplane, coined in the nineteenth century, was trimmed to plane and became everyday speech.
items.cn: 十九世纪造出的 aeroplane 缩略为 plane，成了日常口语。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the planus family; the near-meaning group gathers flat surfaces and flight.
note.cn: 形近组收 planus 词族；近义组收平面与飞行词。

entries.definition: Flat land, unadorned style or clear speech; the twin spelling of plane.
entries.definitionCN: 平地、朴素或直白；plane 的孪生拼法。

entries.definition: A drawing of the future; one letter apart from plane.
entries.definitionCN: 未来的图纸；与 plane 相差一个字母。

entries.definition: Flat high ground; the same root in French dress.
entries.definitionCN: 平坦高地；同词根的法语装束。

entries.definition: The outside layer of a thing, flat or curved.
entries.definitionCN: 物体的外层，可平可曲。

entries.definition: Any flying machine, including helicopters, not only fixed-wing planes.
entries.definitionCN: 任何飞行器，含直升机，不限于固定翼飞机。

entries.definition: A fast plane powered by jet engines.
entries.definitionCN: 喷气发动机驱动的快速飞机。

normalIntro.en: Three homophones share one sound; memory works best by keeping their pictures apart.
normalIntro.cn: 三个同音词共一个读音；记忆的关键是把三幅画分开。

normal.en: Plane the surface, plane the wood, plane the sky: flat, flat, flat.
normal.cn: plane 表面、plane 木头、plane 天空：平、平、平。

normal.en: Plain is flat land, plane is a flat surface — swap letters, swap worlds.
normal.cn: plain 是平地，plane 是平面——换字母，换世界。

normal.en: The carpenter's plane literally makes wood planus.
normal.cn: 木工刨字面上就是把木头弄成 planus。

normal.en: Plane trees line Paris boulevards; they never fly.
normal.cn: 悬铃木排满巴黎的林荫道；它们从不飞。

normal.en: Aeroplane trimmed itself to plane, like aeroplane to air in compounds.
normal.cn: aeroplane 把自己裁成 plane，复合词里又裁成 air。

abstract.en: A sheet of glass with no thickness, only two dimensions.
abstract.cn: 一块玻璃，没有厚度，只有两个维度。

abstract.en: A wing gliding level across a sky of layers.
abstract.cn: 一片机翼在层层天空上水平滑翔。

abstract.en: Wood shavings curling off a blade pushed along a board.
abstract.cn: 刨子推过木板，刨花卷起。

examples.en: We caught the early plane to Dublin.
examples.cn: 我们赶上了飞都柏林的早班机。

examples.en: Geometry begins with the idea of a flat plane.
examples.cn: 几何学从平面的概念开始。

examples.en: He planed the edge until it was perfectly smooth.
examples.cn: 他把边缘刨到完全平滑。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「扑累嗯」——飞机扑着云层飞到累嗯；plane 就是飞机、平面。

root: plane（平面、刨子）源自拉丁语 planus/planum（平的），经法语进入英语；plane（悬铃木）来自另一个拉丁词 platanus；plane（飞机）是 aeroplane 的缩略——三者同形不同源。

sensesIntro.en: One spelling gathers a geometric surface, a level of thought, a woodworking tool, a tree and a flying machine.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个拼法收纳了几何平面、思想层次、木工刨、一种树和一架飞行器。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a surface flattened until nothing rises above it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个被削平到没有任何东西高出来的表面。

branches.en: the perfect surface without thickness
the argument lifted to another level
branches.cn: 抬升到另一层次的争论

branches.en: the wing riding level air
branches.cn: 骑在水平气流上的机翼

branches.en: the blade flattening rough wood
from geometry to the levels of thought

intro.en: Plane's family splits into the planus root and the unrelated platanus tree word.
intro.cn: plane 的词族分成 planus 词根与不相干的 platanus 树名两条线。

latinIntro.en: The planus root also produced plain, plan, plateau and explain.
latinIntro.cn: planus 词根还生出了 plain、plan、plateau 与 explain。

latinEntries.meaning: an English derivative of the headword
latinEntries.meaningCN: air 与 plane 合成，义为「飞机」

latinEntries.meaning: an English derivative of the headword
latinEntries.meaningCN: plane 加 -er 构成，义为「刨床」

definition_zh: 行星；地球；星球
definition_en: a large round object that moves around a star, especially one of the eight that circle the Sun
core_image: 夜空里不眨眼的流浪者——别的星星钉在原地，它在缓缓移动
scene: 他用天文望远镜找到了木星，那颗亮星在镜头里安安静静。The planet Jupiter glowed steadily through his telescope.
sceneCN: 这里是「行星」（第 1 个义项：绕恒星运行的星体）；句意为木星透过他的望远镜稳定地发亮。画面就是夜空中那颗稳稳发光的星。

derivatives.zh: planet 加 -ary 构成的形容词，义为「行星的；全球的」
planet 加拉丁后缀 -arium 构成，义为「天文馆」
planet 加 -oid 构成，义为「小行星状天体」

senses.title: A body orbiting a star
senses.definition: a large spherical body orbiting a star and clearing its own path
senses.definitionCN: 绕恒星运行、清空自身轨道的大型球状天体
senses.example: Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun.
senses.exampleCN: 火星是离太阳第四近的行星。
senses.why: Greek planasthai meant to wander: the ancients saw stars that moved against the fixed sky.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 planasthai 意为游荡：古人看见有几颗星逆着不动的星空移动。

senses.title: The Earth
senses.definition: the planet that we live on, as one world among many
senses.definitionCN: 我们居住的这颗行星，众世界中的一个
senses.example: We must protect the planet for future generations.
senses.exampleCN: 我们必须为后代保护地球。
senses.why: Our own wandering star was recognized as a planet too, and the whole world shrank into one word.
senses.whyCN: 我们自己的这颗星也被认作行星，整个世界缩进一个词里。

senses.title: A wandering celestial body in old astronomy
senses.definition: in traditional astronomy, any of the seven moving lights including Sun and Moon
senses.definitionCN: 传统天文学中七个移动的天体，包括日与月
senses.example: Old charts listed the Sun among the seven planets.
senses.exampleCN: 古老的星表把太阳列入七游星。
senses.why: Before orbits were understood, wanderer covered Sun, Moon and five visible planets alike.
senses.whyCN: 在理解轨道之前，「游荡者」把日月与五颗可见行星一网打尽。

intro.en: Planet descends from a Greek verb of wandering: stars that drifted across the fixed sky were named for their motion.
intro.cn: planet 源自一个表示游荡的希腊动词：那些在不动星空上漂移的星以它们的运动得名。

items.en: Planēs meant wanderer, from planasthai, to wander; the error of navigation gave the word a wrong turn.
items.cn: 希腊语 planēs 意为流浪者，出自 planasthai（游荡）；导航的偏差曾把词引向歧义。

items.en: Late Latin planeta borrowed the Greek noun for the moving stars.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 planeta 借入希腊名词，指移动的星。

items.en: Old French planete passed the word into medieval learning.
items.cn: 古法语 planete 把词传进中世纪学术。

items.en: English took planet in the twelfth century, still including Sun and Moon in the seven.
items.cn: 英语约十二世纪借入 planet，七游星里仍包括日月。

items.en: After Copernicus and Kepler the word narrowed to bodies orbiting the Sun, then widened to exoplanets.
items.cn: 哥白尼与开普勒之后词义收窄为绕日天体，近年又扩展到系外行星。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the planus-planet word cluster; the near-meaning group gathers sky bodies.
note.cn: 形近组收 planus-planet 词簇；近义组收天体。

entries.definition: Relating to planets, or spreading across the whole world.
entries.definitionCN: 行星的；或波及全球的。

entries.definition: A living organism in soil; one letter apart from planet and unrelated in origin.
entries.definitionCN: 种在土里的生物；与 planet 相差一个字母，词源无关。

entries.definition: A flat surface or an aircraft; a different Latin root entirely.
entries.definitionCN: 平面或飞机；拉丁词根完全不同。

entries.definition: A self-luminous ball of gas; what a planet orbits, not what a planet is.
entries.definitionCN: 自己发光的气体球；是行星绕的对象，不是行星本身。

entries.definition: A natural satellite orbiting a planet.
entries.definitionCN: 绕行星运行的自然卫星。

entries.definition: A small rocky body, too little to be called a planet.
entries.definitionCN: 小岩质天体，不够格称为行星。

normalIntro.en: One Greek verb of wandering carries the whole history; memory leans on the moving star.
normalIntro.cn: 一个表示游荡的希腊动词承载全部历史；记忆靠那颗移动的星。

normal.en: Planēs, wanderer: planets are the stars that refuse to stand still.
normal.cn: planēs，流浪者：行星就是不肯站定的星。

normal.en: Planet and plane share no root — the resemblance is pure coincidence.
normal.cn: planet 与 plane 并不同根——形近纯属巧合。

normal.en: The seven old wanderers included the Sun and Moon.
normal.cn: 古七游星里也包括太阳和月亮。

normal.en: Save the planet makes Earth one planet among billions.
normal.cn: save the planet 把地球说成亿万行星中的一颗。

normal.en: Planetarium is the wanderer's museum.
normal.cn: planetarium 是流浪者的博物馆。

abstract.en: A bright point sliding slowly night by night against the fixed pattern.
abstract.cn: 一个亮点逐夜在固定星图中缓缓滑动。

abstract.en: The blue marble seen from orbit, a world made small.
abstract.cn: 从轨道上看去的蓝色弹珠，世界变小的样子。

abstract.en: An old astronomer's chart with seven lights, two of them the Sun and Moon.
abstract.cn: 老天文学家的星图上画着七个天体，其中两个是日月。

examples.en: Saturn is the planet with the brightest rings.
examples.cn: 土星是环最亮的行星。

examples.en: Small acts can still help the planet.
examples.cn: 小小的行动也仍然能帮助地球。

examples.en: Astronomers found a planet around a distant star.
examples.cn: 天文学家在遥远的恒星旁发现了一颗行星。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「扑来了特」——那颗星扑面而来特别会游荡；planet 就是行星。

root: planet 源自希腊语 planēs（流浪者，出自 planasthai「游荡」），经晚期拉丁语 planeta、古法语 planete 进入英语；本指在星空上移动的星体，后专指绕恒星运行的行星。

sensesIntro.en: A wanderer of the old sky narrows into a proper astronomical planet and then widens again to mean our whole world.
sensesIntro.cn: 旧天文学的游荡之星先是收窄为严格意义的行星，再扩展为整个地球。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a light that moves where other lights stand still.
core.cn: 核心意象：别的光都站定，唯独它在移动。

branches.en: the star that refuses to stand still
the blue world under our feet
the Sun and Moon in the old seven
the path each body clears by its own weight
branches.cn: 各天体用自己的引力清出的路径

branches.en: from moving lights to saving our one world
branches.cn: 从移动的光到拯救我们仅有的世界

intro.en: Planet's family uses Greek wandering and Latin endings; it is not related to plane or plant despite appearances.
intro.cn: planet 的词族用的是希腊的「游荡」与拉丁词尾；尽管形似，它与 plane、plant 无关。

latinIntro.en: Late Latin planeta and its suffixes -ary, -arium and -oid built the modern family.
latinIntro.cn: 晚期拉丁语 planeta 与词尾 -ary、-arium、-oid 建起了现代词族。

latinEntries.meaning: an English derivative of the headword
latinEntries.meaningCN: planet 加 -ary 构成，义为「行星的」

latinEntries.meaning: an English derivative of the headword
latinEntries.meaningCN: planet 加 -arium 构成，义为「天文馆」

definition_zh: 植物；工厂；栽种；种植；安插（动词）
definition_en: a living thing that grows in soil, or a factory, or to put something in the ground or into a position
core_image: 一株苗被按进土里——根扎下去，根同时也能扎进车间和名单
scene: 春天的菜园里，孩子们蹲在垄沟边把番茄苗一棵棵埋进土里。The children planted tomato seedlings along the furrow.
sceneCN: 这里是「栽种」（第 3 个义项：把植物种进土里）；句意为孩子们沿垄沟栽下番茄苗。画面就是那双按苗入土的小手。

derivatives.zh: plant 加拉丁式后缀 -ation 构成，义为「种植园；大农场」
plant 加 -er 构成的名词，义为「种植者；播种机；花盆」
re-（重新）+ plant，义为「补种；移栽」
im-（进入）+ plant，义为「植入；灌注（观念）」

senses.title: A living organism of the soil
senses.definition: a living thing with roots, stems and leaves that grows in soil and makes food from sunlight
senses.definitionCN: 有根茎叶、长在土里、靠阳光造养分的生物
senses.example: Every plant on the balcony needed watering daily.
senses.exampleCN: 阳台上的每盆植物都要每天浇水。
senses.why: Old English plante named a seedling pressed into the earth, before it widened to the whole kingdom of green life.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 plante 原指按进土里的幼苗，后来扩大到整个绿色生命的王国。

senses.title: A factory or its machinery
senses.definition: a factory, or the heavy machinery inside it
senses.definitionCN: 工厂，或厂内的重型设备
senses.example: The steel plant employs two thousand workers.
senses.exampleCN: 这家钢厂雇佣两千名工人。
senses.why: The image of planting machinery in place grew in industrial English: fixed roots of iron.
senses.whyCN: 把机器「栽」在原地的意象生长于工业英语：钢铁也有固定不动的根。

senses.title: To put into the ground to grow
senses.definition: to put seeds or young plants into soil so they grow
senses.definitionCN: 把种子或幼苗放进土里使其生长
senses.example: They planted rice in flooded fields.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在淹水的田里插秧。
senses.why: The noun's oldest action: pressing a seedling into the earth by hand.
senses.whyCN: 名词最古老的动作：用手把幼苗按进土里。

senses.title: To place firmly or secretly
senses.definition: to place something somewhere firmly or in hiding
senses.definitionCN: 把某物牢牢或秘密地放到某处
senses.example: Someone planted a camera in the office.
senses.exampleCN: 有人偷偷在办公室装了摄像头。
senses.why: A thing pressed into soil stays fixed; the same pressing became hiding or fixing objects.
senses.whyCN: 压进土里的东西不会动；同一种「按压」变成了藏匿或安装物件。

senses.title: To introduce ideas or people
senses.definition: to put an idea into someone's mind or a person into a position for a purpose
senses.definitionCN: 把想法放进某人脑中，或把人安插进某个位置
senses.example: The rumor had been planted by a rival.
senses.exampleCN: 这谣言是竞争对手散布的。
senses.why: Ideas, too, can be pressed into a mind like seeds, growing unseen afterwards.
senses.whyCN: 想法同样能像种子一样按进头脑，之后悄悄生长。

intro.en: Plant is a Latin word of pressing: to push a shoot into the soil with your foot, and from that simple act the whole family grew.
intro.cn: plant 来自一个表示「按压」的拉丁词：用脚把嫩枝踩进土里，整个词族就从这个简单动作里长出。

items.en: Planta meant the sole of the foot, and the verb plantare meant to press a shoot in with the foot.
items.cn: 拉丁语 planta 指脚掌；动词 plantare 意为用脚把苗踩进土里。

items.en: The sense settled on seedlings and on setting them out.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语义固定在幼苗及移栽上。

items.en: Plante arrived in Old English directly from Latin through early borrowing.
items.cn: 古英语 plante 直接从拉丁语早期借入。

items.en: Industrial and figurative senses — factories, planted ideas, planted spies — grew after the seventeenth century.
items.cn: 工厂、栽赃、安插眼线等工业与比喻义在十七世纪后长出。

items.en: Now plant spans botany, industry, sabotage and psychology.
items.cn: 如今 plant 跨越植物学、工业、破坏行动与心理影响。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the plant family and one famous look-alike; the near-meaning group gathers green life and factories.
note.cn: 形近组收 plant 词族与一个著名形近词；近义组收绿色生命与工厂词。

entries.definition: A large farm of planted crops, historically of cotton or sugar.
entries.definitionCN: 大规模种植园，历史上种棉花或甘蔗。

entries.definition: A wandering star; one letter apart from plant and unrelated in origin.
entries.definitionCN: 游荡之星；与 plant 相差一个字母，词源无关。

entries.definition: To set something into a body or a mind.
entries.definitionCN: 把东西植入身体或心里。

entries.definition: The plants of a region collectively, named for a goddess.
entries.definitionCN: 某地区的植物总称，得名于女神。

entries.definition: A building where goods are made; the everyday word beside plant.
entries.definitionCN: 制造产品的建筑；与 plant 并用的日常词。

entries.definition: What is planted first, before the plant exists.
entries.definitionCN: 植物存在之前先被种下的东西。

normalIntro.en: One action — pressing a shoot into soil — powers every sense, from gardens to factories to minds.
normalIntro.cn: 一个动作——把苗按进土里——驱动所有义项，从菜园到工厂到人心。

normal.en: Latin planta first meant the sole of the foot that presses the seedling down.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 planta 最先指把幼苗踩进土里的那只脚掌。

normal.en: A power plant is machinery planted into place.
normal.cn: 发电厂就是被栽在原地的机器。

normal.en: Planted evidence is the dark side of planting seeds.
normal.cn: 栽赃证据是播种的黑暗面。

normal.en: Implant and replant reuse the same pressing action.
normal.cn: implant 与 replant 复用同一个按压动作。

normal.en: Plant and planet differ by one letter and a whole universe.
normal.cn: plant 与 planet 只差一个字母，却隔了整个宇宙。

abstract.en: A small hand pressing soil around a green stem.
abstract.cn: 一只小手把土按在绿茎周围。

abstract.en: Chimneys rooted into the ground like trunks.
abstract.cn: 烟囱像树干一样扎在地里。

abstract.en: A rumor sprouting quietly in a mind left unattended.
abstract.cn: 一个谣言在无人看管的头脑里悄悄发芽。

examples.en: We planted herbs along the kitchen window.
examples.cn: 我们在厨房窗边种了香草。

examples.en: The new plant will open next spring.
examples.cn: 新工厂明年春天投产。

examples.en: Someone had planted a false story in the press.
examples.cn: 有人向媒体散布了假消息。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「扑蓝特」——把苗按进蓝天下特制的土里；plant 就是种、植物。

root: plant 源自拉丁语 planta（脚掌）与 plantare（用脚把苗踩进土里），经古英语 plante 进入英语；由「按压入土」引申出栽种、安放、安插与工厂义。

sensesIntro.en: A foot pressing a shoot into soil grows into botany, industry, sabotage and the planting of ideas.
sensesIntro.cn: 一只把苗踩进土里的脚，长出了植物学、工业、破坏行动与灌输想法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: something pressed down into a place until it stays and grows.
core.cn: 核心意象：某物被按进一个地方，直到它站稳、生长。

branches.en: the kingdom of rooted green life
machinery with roots in concrete
branches.cn: 把根扎进混凝土的机器

branches.en: the camera hidden in the office
branches.cn: 藏在办公室里的摄像头

branches.en: the rumor pressed into a mind
from seeds in soil to ideas in heads
branches.cn: 从土里的种子到头脑里的想法

intro.en: Plant is a full Latin citizen: prefixes and heavy suffixes grow naturally on this root.
intro.cn: plant 是拉丁语的正牌公民：前缀与厚重的后缀都能自然长在这个词根上。

latinIntro.en: The root planta (sole of the foot) feeds plant, implant, replant and plantation.
latinIntro.cn: 词根 planta（脚掌）供养着 plant、implant、replant 与 plantation。

latinEntries.meaning: an English derivative of the headword
latinEntries.meaningCN: plant 加 -ation 构成，义为「种植园」

latinEntries.meaning: an English derivative of the headword
latinEntries.meaningCN: im- 与 plant 合成，义为「植入」

definition_zh: 塑料；可塑的；不自然的（形容词）
definition_en: a light synthetic material made from petroleum, or able to be moulded, or artificial in look or manner
core_image: 一块受热就听话变形的材料——软下来任你捏，冷下去定型不变
scene: 他拧开瓶盖，把矿泉水倒进杯里，瓶身轻轻咔咔作响。He crushed the empty plastic bottle before dropping it into the bin.
sceneCN: 这里是「塑料」（第 1 个义项：石油合成的轻质材料）；句意为他把空塑料瓶捏瘪再丢进垃圾桶。画面就是那块一捏就变形的材料。

pos.zh: 可塑的；塑料制的；虚假做作的

derivatives.zh: plastic 加 -ity 构成的名词，义为「可塑性」
plastic 加动词后缀 -ize 构成，义为「使塑化」
plastic 与 surgeon 合成，义为「整形外科医生」

senses.title: A synthetic mouldable material
senses.definition: a light synthetic material made from petroleum polymers, moulded when soft
senses.definitionCN: 由石油聚合物制成的轻质合成材料，受热软化可塑形
senses.example: The toy is made of hard plastic.
senses.exampleCN: 这个玩具由硬塑料制成。
senses.why: Greek plassein meant to mould, and the new materials were named for their willingness to take any shape.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 plassein 意为捏塑，新材料因「愿意变成任何形状」而得名。

senses.title: Able to be moulded
senses.definition: able to change shape easily, especially under heat or pressure
senses.definitionCN: 容易变形，尤指在受热或受压时
senses.example: Clay is plastic while it is wet.
senses.exampleCN: 湿的时候黏土是可塑的。
senses.why: The oldest meaning belongs to craft: any material that obeys the shaping hand.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的意义属于手艺：任何服从塑形之手的材料。

senses.title: Artificial or insincere
senses.definition: looking or behaving in an artificial, lifeless way
senses.definitionCN: 看起来或表现得人工、没有生气
senses.example: The actors exchanged plastic smiles.
senses.exampleCN: 演员们交换着假笑。
senses.why: Perfect moulded surfaces never change, so the word slid to people whose smiles seem manufactured.
senses.whyCN: 完美的模塑表面永不变化，这个词便滑向笑容像被造出来的假面人。

senses.title: Related to shaping tissue
senses.definition: involving surgery that reshapes body tissue
senses.definitionCN: 涉及重塑身体组织的手术
senses.example: Plastic surgery repaired the burn scars.
senses.exampleCN: 整形手术修复了烧伤疤痕。
senses.why: Here plastic keeps its medical sense of moulding living tissue, not the material.
senses.whyCN: 这里的 plastic 保留「塑造活体组织」的医学义，与材料无关。

senses.title: Credit cards in slang
senses.definition: credit cards, as rectangular plastic objects used to pay
senses.definitionCN: 用来付款的矩形塑料卡片，即信用卡
senses.example: He paid with plastic at the till.
senses.exampleCN: 他在收银台刷卡付款。
senses.why: The material's name stands in for the everyday object made of it, as plastics do for money.
senses.whyCN: 材料名替身日常物件，塑料替了钱包里的钱。

intro.en: Plastic comes from a Greek verb of moulding, passed through Latin and Italian to name both the art of shaping and the modern moulded material.
intro.cn: plastic 来自一个希腊语的捏塑动词，经拉丁语与意大利语，既命名塑造之艺，也命名现代模塑材料。

items.en: Plassein meant to mould or form, the root of plastic art.
items.cn: 希腊语 plassein 意为捏塑、成形，是造型艺术的词根。

items.en: Plasticus entered Latin as a medical and artistic adjective for shaping.
items.cn: plasticus 以医学与艺术形容词的身份进入拉丁语，指塑形。

items.en: Italian plastica named the arts of modelling and reconstructive surgery.
items.cn: 意大利语 plastica 指塑形技艺与重建外科。

items.en: English borrowed plastic in the seventeenth century for anything mouldable.
items.cn: 英语十七世纪借入 plastic，指一切可塑之物。

items.en: The twentieth-century plastics industry fixed the material sense, while older uses lived on in surgery and insult.
items.cn: 二十世纪塑料工业确立了材料义，旧义仍活在整形外科和讽刺里。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the plassein family; the near-meaning group gathers synthetic materials and moulding words.
note.cn: 形近组收 plassein 词族；近义组收合成材料与可塑词。

entries.definition: The quality of being able to change shape, of matter or of brains.
entries.definitionCN: 物质或大脑的可塑性。

entries.definition: A soft modelling clay sold under a trademark.
entries.definitionCN: 一种软塑泥，商标名转为通名。

entries.definition: An explosion; rhymes with plastic's first syllable but has a different root.
entries.definitionCN: 爆炸；与 plastic 首音节押韵，词根不同。

entries.definition: Made by chemical synthesis rather than nature.
entries.definitionCN: 化学合成而非天然形成。

entries.definition: Able to be hammered or pressed into shape without breaking.
entries.definitionCN: 能被锤打或按压成形而不断裂。

entries.definition: The natural mouldable earth that plastic replaced in many uses.
entries.definitionCN: 天然的塑形之土，许多用途上被塑料取代。

normalIntro.en: One Greek verb of moulding explains every sense, from clay to credit cards to fake smiles.
normalIntro.cn: 一个希腊捏塑动词解释所有义项，从黏土到信用卡到假笑。

normal.en: Plassein, to mould: plastic is the material that obeys.
normal.cn: plassein，捏塑：plastic 就是听话的材料。

normal.en: Plastic surgery moulds flesh, not polymers.
normal.cn: plastic surgery 塑造的是肉，不是聚合物。

normal.en: A plastic smile is moulded, not felt.
normal.cn: plastic smile 是被塑出来的，不是被感受的。

normal.en: Paying with plastic means paying with a moulded card.
normal.cn: pay with plastic 是用一块模塑卡片付款。

normal.en: Plasticity of the brain borrows the craft sense back into science.
normal.cn: 大脑的可塑性把手艺义借回了科学。

abstract.en: A sheet of soft polymer bending around a finger.
abstract.cn: 一片软聚合物绕着手指弯曲。

abstract.en: A smile too symmetrical, set like a moulded surface.
abstract.cn: 一个过于对称、像模塑表面一样定型的笑容。

abstract.en: A landfill of coloured bottles that never rot.
abstract.cn: 填埋场上永不腐烂的彩色瓶子。

examples.en: Plastic waste now fills every ocean.
examples.cn: 塑料垃圾如今污染了每片海洋。

examples.en: The wet clay is still plastic enough to shape.
examples.cn: 湿黏土还软得可以塑形。

examples.en: Her greeting felt plastic and rehearsed.
examples.cn: 她的问候显得做作而生硬。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「扑拉斯踢克」——塑料一烤就软，踢一脚就变形，特听话；plastic 就是塑料。

root: plastic 源自希腊语 plassein（捏塑、成形），经拉丁语 plasticus、意大利语 plastica 进入英语；先指「可塑的」，二十世纪塑料工业后成为材料名，另保留「整形」与「做作」义。

sensesIntro.en: A Greek verb of moulding gives its name to clay under the hand, polymers under heat, tissue under the scalpel and smiles under social pressure.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个希腊捏塑动词的名字给了手里的黏土、加热的聚合物、手术刀下的组织和社交压力下的笑容。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a material that takes whatever shape the hand imposes.
core.cn: 核心意象：手给什么形状，它就接受什么形状。

branches.en: the polymer that obeys heat
wet clay under the thumb
the scalpel reshaping skin
the smile set by a mould
from bottle to credit card

intro.en: Plastic carries its Greek root into several endings, medical terms and brand names.
intro.cn: plastic 带着希腊词根进入若干词尾、医学术语和品牌名。

latinIntro.en: The root plassein also appears in plasma and plaster through other routes.
latinIntro.cn: 词根 plassein 经其他路径还出现在 plasma 与 plaster 中。

latinEntries.meaning: an English derivative of the headword
latinEntries.meaningCN: plastic 加 -ity 构成，义为「可塑性」

latinEntries.meaning: an English derivative of the headword
latinEntries.meaningCN: plastic 与 surgeon 合成，义为「整形外科医生」

definition_zh: 盘子；板；金属板；车牌；板块（名词）；电镀（动词）
definition_en: a flat dish for food, or a flat sheet of metal, or a tectonic slab, or to cover with a thin metal layer
core_image: 一块又平又薄的片——盛饭的盘、护身的板、地下的块
scene: 餐桌上她把热汤碗端起，顺手摞好旁边洗干净的盘子。She stacked each clean plate beside the sink after dinner.
sceneCN: 这里是「盘子」（第 1 个义项：盛食物的扁平器皿）；句意为晚饭后她把洗净的盘子一个个摞在水槽边。画面就是那摞又平又薄的圆盘。

pos.zh: 盘子；板；金属板；车牌；板块

derivatives.zh: plate 的过去分词作形容词，义为「镀的；装甲板的」
经法语与 plate 同源于拉丁语 plattus，义为「高原；平台期」
plate 加 -er 构成的名词，义为「大浅盘」

senses.title: A flat dish for food
senses.definition: a shallow flat dish from which food is eaten
senses.definitionCN: 吃饭用的浅平底器皿
senses.example: The waiter cleared the plates after the main course.
senses.exampleCN: 主菜撤下后侍者收盘子。
senses.why: Spanish plata, silver, named the flat metal dishes the wealthy ate from, and the shape outlived the metal.
senses.whyCN: 西班牙语 plata（银）命名了富人的扁平银器，器形活得比银久。

senses.title: A flat sheet of metal
senses.definition: a flat, thin piece of metal used in construction or armour
senses.definitionCN: 用于建筑或护甲的扁平薄金属片
senses.example: The hull was riveted with steel plates.
senses.exampleCN: 船壳用钢板铆接。
senses.why: The same flatness applied to metal sheets laid flat like dishes on a frame.
senses.whyCN: 同一种平坦挪到金属板上——像盘子一样平铺在骨架上。

senses.title: A vehicle's registration plate
senses.definition: the flat metal sign showing a vehicle's registration number
senses.definitionCN: 标示车辆注册号码的扁平金属牌
senses.example: The traffic camera caught the car's plate.
senses.exampleCN: 交通摄像头拍到了那辆车的车牌。
senses.why: A small flat sheet of metal fixed onto the car keeps the dish-flat shape.
senses.whyCN: 固定在车上的小金属片仍保留盘子的扁平形。

senses.title: A tectonic plate
senses.definition: one of the huge slabs of rock that form the Earth's surface
senses.definitionCN: 构成地球表面的巨大岩石板块之一
senses.example: The Pacific plate grinds slowly beneath the continent.
senses.exampleCN: 太平洋板块在大陆下缓慢碾磨。
senses.why: Earth's crust broke into flat sheets, so geology borrowed the metal sense for the planet's skin.
senses.whyCN: 地壳裂成扁平的板片，地质学便借金属板义来称这层行星表皮。

senses.title: A photographic or printing plate
senses.definition: a light-sensitive sheet or printing surface in photography and printing
senses.definitionCN: 摄影或印刷中的感光片或印制板面
senses.example: The printer prepared a plate for the front page.
senses.exampleCN: 印刷工备好了头版的印版。
senses.why: A flat sheet again, this time carrying an image or a light-sensitive coating.
senses.whyCN: 又一块平片，这次承载的是图像或感光涂层。

senses.title: To coat with a metal layer
senses.definition: to cover something with a thin layer of metal by electrolysis
senses.definitionCN: 用电解法给某物镀上薄金属层
senses.example: The silver parts were plated to resist rust.
senses.exampleCN: 银件经过电镀以防锈。
senses.why: The metal sheet becomes a verb: to lay a flat film of metal onto a surface.
senses.whyCN: 金属片变成动词：往表面铺一层平整的金属膜。

intro.en: Plate entered English through Spanish plata, silver, from a Latin word for flat metal — the flatness survived even when silver gave way to tin.
intro.cn: plate 经西班牙语 plata（银）进入英语，来自一个指扁平金属的拉丁词——即使银换成了锡，「平」也留了下来。

items.en: Reconstructed plattus described flat metal, possibly from Greek platys, broad.
items.cn: 一般认为源自重构拉丁词 plattus（扁平金属），或与希腊语 platys（宽）有关。

items.en: Spanish plata came to mean silver, the metal of flat dishes.
items.cn: 西班牙语 plata 渐指银——做扁平餐具的金属。

items.en: Old French plate kept the flatness and lost the precious metal.
items.cn: 古法语 plate 保住了「平」，丢了贵金属。

items.en: English took the word in the thirteenth century for flat metal pieces and dishes.
items.cn: 十三世纪英语借入该词，指金属板与餐具。

items.en: Printing, geology and electroplating each gave the flat sheet a new job.
items.cn: 印刷、地质与电镀各自给这块平片派了新差事。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the flat-family and sound-alikes; the near-meaning group gathers dishes, sheets and slabs.
note.cn: 形近组收「平」词族与音近词；近义组收餐具、板与板片。

entries.definition: Flat highland or a stalled level; one syllable longer than plate.
entries.definitionCN: 平坦高地或停滞期；比 plate 多一个音节。

entries.definition: A large shallow dish, or an old word for a record.
entries.definitionCN: 大浅盘，或旧时的唱片说法。

entries.definition: A tiny cell fragment in blood that clots wounds; literally a little plate.
entries.definitionCN: 血液里止血的小细胞碎片，字面即「小板」。

entries.definition: A container for food, deeper than a plate, also a cooked course.
entries.definitionCN: 食物容器，比盘子深，也指一道菜。

entries.definition: A broad flat piece of any material.
entries.definitionCN: 任何材料的宽平片。

entries.definition: A thick flat block of stone or concrete.
entries.definitionCN: 厚而平的石块或混凝土块。

normalIntro.en: Every sense is a flat piece: remember one flat shape and all uses follow.
normalIntro.cn: 所有义项都是一块平片：记住这个扁平形，各用法随之而来。

normal.en: Plate began as flat silver — plata still means money's metal in Spanish.
normal.cn: plate 最初是扁平的银器——西班牙语 plata 至今指银。

normal.en: License plates, steel plates, tectonic plates: all flat sheets.
normal.cn: 车牌、钢板、板块：全都是平片。

normal.en: Plate tectonics makes the Earth's skin a dinner service.
normal.cn: 板块构造把地球表皮变成一套餐具。

normal.en: Clean your plate is the dinner-table imperative.
normal.cn: clean your plate 是餐桌上的命令句。

normal.en: Plated cutlery wears out where solid silver does not.
normal.cn: 镀银餐具会磨损，纯银不会。

abstract.en: A round white disc sliding across a kitchen counter.
abstract.cn: 一只白圆盘滑过厨房台面。

abstract.en: The Earth's skin cracked like a dinner service on a globe.
abstract.cn: 地球表皮像套在球体上的餐具一样裂开。

abstract.en: A thin silver film growing on dull metal in a bubbling bath.
abstract.cn: 冒泡的镀液里，一层银膜在暗色金属上慢慢长出。

examples.en: He wiped every plate before stacking them.
examples.cn: 他把每只盘子都擦干净才摞起来。

examples.en: The license plate was muddy and unreadable.
examples.cn: 车牌沾满泥，看不清号码。

examples.en: Jewellery is often plated with gold over silver.
examples.cn: 首饰常在银上镀金。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「普雷特」——普普通通一个盘，拿来盛饭特别合适；plate 就是盘子。

root: plate 经西班牙语 plata（银）与古法语 plate 追至重构拉丁词 plattus（扁平金属，或与希腊语 platys「宽」相关）进入英语；核心义为「扁平薄片」，衍生出盘、板、牌、板块与电镀。

sensesIntro.en: One flat sheet of metal grows a dinner service, a hull, a licence, the Earth's cracked skin and a photographic surface.
sensesIntro.cn: 一块扁平金属片长出了成套餐具、船壳、车牌、地球开裂的表皮和照相版面。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a flat piece of something, thin enough to lay on a surface.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块足够薄、可以平放的东西。

branches.en: the round white dish at dinner
the riveted armour of a ship
the grinding slabs underfoot
the silver film laid by electric current
from the table setting to the planet's skin
branches.cn: 从餐桌摆盘到行星表皮

intro.en: Plate's family is built on flatness: diminutives, enlargers and French cousins.
intro.cn: plate 的词族建立在「平」上：指小词、放大词与法语表亲。

latinIntro.en: The plattus-platys root also gave plateau, platter and platelet.
latinIntro.cn: plattus-platys 词根还给了 plateau、platter 与 platelet。

latinEntries.meaning: an English derivative of the headword
latinEntries.meaningCN: plate 加 -let 构成，义为「血小板」

latinEntries.meaning: an English derivative of the headword
latinEntries.meaningCN: plate 加 -er 构成，义为「大浅盘」

definition_zh: 平台；站台；讲台；政纲；立足点
definition_en: a raised flat surface for people to stand on, a station area beside tracks, or a set of political promises
core_image: 一片被抬高、垫平的板面——人站上去，声音和列车都从这里出发
scene: 候车的人们站在黄线后面，眼睛盯着显示屏上的车次。The passengers waited on the platform for the morning express.
sceneCN: 这里是「站台」（第 2 个义项：铁路轨道旁供上下车的平台）；句意为乘客们在站台上等早班快车。画面就是那片抬起的人造平地。

derivatives.zh: platform 加 -er 构成的名词，义为「平台跳跃类游戏」
cross 与 platform 合成，义为「跨平台的」

senses.title: A raised flat surface
senses.definition: a raised level surface built for people or things to stand on
senses.definitionCN: 为让人或物立足而建的抬高平面
senses.example: The speaker stepped onto the wooden platform.
senses.exampleCN: 发言人走上木讲台。
senses.why: French plate-forme joined flatness to shape: literally a flat form lifted above the ground.
senses.whyCN: 法语 plate-forme 把「平」与「形」结合：字面即抬离地面的平坦形体。

senses.title: A station area beside tracks
senses.definition: the raised area beside railway tracks where passengers board
senses.definitionCN: 铁轨旁供乘客上下车的抬高地面
senses.example: Mind the gap between the train and the platform.
senses.exampleCN: 小心列车与站台之间的空隙。
senses.why: The raised surface became the place where journeys start and end.
senses.whyCN: 抬高的平面变成了旅程开始与结束之处。

senses.title: A set of political promises
senses.definition: the declared aims and promises of a political party
senses.definitionCN: 政党宣布的目标与承诺
senses.example: Tax reform stands first in their platform.
senses.exampleCN: 税改列在他们政纲的第一条。
senses.why: The party stands on its promises as on a raised stage, presenting itself to be seen.
senses.whyCN: 政党站在承诺之上如同站在高台，把自己呈现给众人看。

senses.title: A base technology for others to build on
senses.definition: a system on which software or services are built and run
senses.definitionCN: 承载软件或服务构建与运行的系统
senses.example: The app runs on every major platform.
senses.exampleCN: 这个应用在所有主流平台上都能运行。
senses.why: Technology borrowed the raised surface: a base others stand on to build higher.
senses.whyCN: 技术界借走这个抬高的平面：让别人站上去建更高的楼。

senses.title: A position from which to speak or act
senses.definition: a chance or position from which one can express views or act
senses.definitionCN: 可以表达观点或采取行动的机会或位置
senses.example: The award gave her a platform to defend the wetlands.
senses.exampleCN: 这个奖项给了她一个为湿地发声的讲坛。
senses.why: Standing on a platform makes a person taller and more visible, so the word moved to influence itself.
senses.whyCN: 站上高台让人更高、更显眼，这个词便移向影响力本身。

intro.en: Platform is French plate-forme in disguise: a flat (plate) form raised above the ground for standing on.
intro.cn: platform 是法语 plate-forme 的变装：一个抬离地面供人立足的平坦（plate）形体。

items.en: Plate-forme combined plate, flat, with forme, shape.
items.cn: 法语 plate-forme 由 plate（平的）与 forme（形）合成。

items.en: Plate descends from Latin plattus or Greek platys, broad and flat.
items.cn: plate 可追至拉丁语 plattus 或希腊语 platys（宽、平）。

items.en: English borrowed platform in the sixteenth century for raised structures.
items.cn: 英语十六世纪借入 platform，指抬高的构筑物。

items.en: The coming of railways fixed the station-platform sense in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 十九世纪铁路兴起，确立了站台义。

items.en: Politics, computing and media each stand on the word today.
items.cn: 如今政治、计算与媒体各踩着这个词。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the flat-family; the near-meaning group gathers raised bases and stages.
note.cn: 形近组收「平」词族；近义组收抬高基座与舞台词。

entries.definition: Flat highland or a stalled stage of progress; shares the plate- root.
entries.definitionCN: 平坦高地或停滞阶段；同 plate- 词根。

entries.definition: A flat dish or metal sheet; the closest English cousin.
entries.definitionCN: 扁平餐具或金属板；最近的英语表亲。

entries.definition: A precious metal; begins with plat- but its name comes from Spanish plata, silver.
entries.definitionCN: 贵金属；以 plat- 开头，但名称来自西班牙语 plata（银）。

entries.definition: A raised floor for performers, also a phase of progress.
entries.definitionCN: 供演出者使用的抬高地板，也指进程阶段。

entries.definition: A small raised stand for a speaker or conductor.
entries.definitionCN: 演讲者或指挥用的小高台。

entries.definition: The foundation something stands on, physical or abstract.
entries.definitionCN: 某物立足的基础，物理或抽象。

normalIntro.en: One image — a raised flat floor — carries stations, stages, manifestos and software alike.
normalIntro.cn: 一个意象——抬高的平面地板——同时承载站台、讲台、政纲与软件。

normal.en: Platform is literally a flat form: plate + form.
normal.cn: platform 字面就是「平的形」：plate 加 form。

normal.en: Mind the gap is said only on platforms.
normal.cn: mind the gap 只在站台里说。

normal.en: A political platform is the stage a party stands on.
normal.cn: 政治政纲就是政党站立的舞台。

normal.en: Every app needs a platform to stand on.
normal.cn: 每个应用都需要可以立足的平台。

normal.en: A platform makes the small speaker taller than the crowd.
normal.cn: 讲台让矮小的发言者高过人群。

abstract.en: A raised deck of boards above the mud, everyone stepping up onto it.
abstract.cn: 泥地上方一块木板高台，人们逐级踩上去。

abstract.en: A train sliding in, its windows level with waiting feet.
abstract.cn: 一列火车滑进站，车窗与候车人的脚齐平。

abstract.en: A microphone lifted above an audience, voices radiating outward.
abstract.cn: 一支话筒被举到观众上方，声音向外扩散。

examples.en: The train drew slowly into platform three.
examples.cn: 列车缓缓驶入三号站台。

examples.en: The party's platform promised lower taxes.
examples.cn: 该党政纲承诺减税。

examples.en: She used her fame as a platform for climate action.
examples.cn: 她把名声用作推动气候行动的平台。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「普莱特福姆」——铺平了、抬高了的台，站上去万事从这出发；platform 就是平台。

root: platform 源自法语 plate-forme（平坦的形体），plate 可追至拉丁语 plattus 或希腊语 platys（宽、平），forme 出自拉丁语 forma（形）；由「抬高的平面」引申出站台、讲台、政纲与技术平台。

sensesIntro.en: A flat form raised above the mud becomes a station edge, a speaker's stage, a party's promises and a software base.
sensesIntro.cn: 一块抬离泥地的平坦形体，变成车站的边缘、发言者的讲台、政党的承诺和软件的基座。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a flat surface lifted so that everyone can see and step onto it.
core.cn: 核心意象：被抬起的平面，让人人可见、可踏足。

branches.en: the deck lifted above the mud
the yellow line by the rails
the promises raised for all to read
branches.cn: 被举起来供众人读的承诺

branches.en: the voice lifted above the crowd
from wooden decks to digital bases

intro.en: Platform is a compound of two borrowed roots, flat and shape, which keeps expanding into modern compounds.
intro.cn: platform 是「平」与「形」两个借入词根的复合词，如今不断长出新的复合词。

latinIntro.en: The plate- flatness root also lives in plate, plateau and platter.
latinIntro.cn: plate- 的「平」词根也活在 plate、plateau 与 platter 里。
